description: Actual wrong route reaches a dead end; reload preserves it and Undo recovers with honest cost
Hint cancel is inert; confirmation discloses rewind and adds exactly one move and hint
Keyboard focus does not spend a move; Enter and Backspace perform scored actions
320–1440 widths have no horizontal overflow; 44px cells and actions immediately below board
Perfect win is immutable and its finished route can be inspected with keyboard
Actual perfect win exports 1080×1350 PNG with played date and score
Square export is 1080×1080 and midnight cannot relabel an existing result
Mocked share cancellation preserves focus without download; blocked clipboard selects caption manually
Practice clears old route inspection; revealed export is honest and daily win persists
No browser page errors
